defs.def: to put sth/sb in a particular place or position 放；置；使处于

ex.t: 里面没有身份证，看起来像是有人翻看过然后放在了所有人都能____26____看到的地方。

ex.t: ●定一个开始时间。

ex.t: 但现在是纠正错误认知的时候了，而这要从质疑"所有社会比较都不健康"这种观点开始。

ex.t: 有时候很难做出改变，但我很高兴我把变革的轮子 和这个很小的第一步一起启动，因为它让我走到今天的地步。

ex.t: 然后你可以打印一份新草稿，再次将文本设为三倍行距。

ex.s: They take their driverless car to an appointment and set the empty vehicle to circle the building to avoid paying for parking.
ex.t: 他们开自动驾驶汽车赴约，让空车绕楼转圈以逃避停车费。

defs.def: to prepare or arrange sth so that it is ready for use or in position 设置；调整好；安排就绪

ex.s: It's said that history is written by the victors, and those victors set the standards for admission to the genius club.
ex.t: 不需要天才也知道答案：绝对不是。

to put a precious stone into a piece of jewellery 镶嵌

ex.t: 养育子女决定了儿童成长的速度。

ex.s: To set an example for the rest of the class.
ex.t: 为了给班上其他同学树立榜样。

defs.def: to give sb a piece of work, a task, etc. 布置；分配；指派

ex.s: Completing many courses no longer brings out the feeling of success because more than four AP classes per year is a norm set by top universities.
ex.t: 完成许多课程不再带来成功感，因为每年超过四门AP课已是顶尖大学设定的常态。

ex.s: Stick to your set bedtime and wake-up time, no matter the day.
ex.t: 坚持你设定的睡觉和起床时间，无论星期几。

ex.s: No, this is for setting my hair yesterday.''
ex.t: “不，这是昨天做头发用的。”

defs.def: to put a broken bone into a fixed position and hold it there, so that it will heal; to heal in this way 把（断骨）复位；接（骨）

ex.s: Set your alarm clock an hour early and push yourself to work out!
ex.t: 把闹钟调早一小时，逼自己去锻炼！

defs.def: to use a machine or computer to arrange writing and images on pages in order to prepare a book, newspaper, etc. for printing 排版
to write music to go with words 为 … 谱曲；给 … 配乐
to go down below the horizon 落（下）

ex.s: As the summer months roll in, our Georgian country estate makes the perfect setting for an outdoor fitness session.
ex.t: 来吧，在我们的合格私人教练乔迪·麦格雷戈的带领下，在米德尔顿庄园的场地上锻炼。

defs.def: to judge sth by comparing good or positive qualities with bad or negative ones 权衡利弊（或优缺点）
to record sth as a business cost as a way of reducing the amount of tax you must pay 把 … 按营业成本记账以降低（税额）
to move sth to one side until you need it 把 … 放到一旁（或搁到一边）
to save or keep money or time for a particular purpose 省出，留出（钱或时间）

ex.s: Set boundaries for yourselfas your time goes
ex.t: 随着时间的推移为自己设定界限

ex.s: Set boundaries for yourself your time goes
ex.t: 随着时间推移，为你自己设定界限。

ex.s: If you want time to have breakfast with your family, save some time the night before by setting out clothes, shoes, and bags.
ex.t: 如果你想有时间和家人一起吃早餐，前一天晚上就把衣服、鞋子和包准备好来节省时间。

ex.s: Data shows that kids and teens who do read frequently, compared to infrequent readers, have more books in the home, more books purchased for them, parents who read more often, and parents who set aside time for them to read.
ex.t: 数据显示，与不常阅读的孩子和青少年相比，经常阅读的孩子和青少年家里有更多的书，为他们购买的书籍更多，父母阅读更频繁，并且父母会为他们留出阅读时间。

ex.s: Once we found the place, it was stressful getting lights and cameras set up in the limited time.
ex.t: 一旦我们找到那个地方，在有限的时间里安装灯光和摄像头 压力很大。

defs.def: to not consider sth, because other things are more important 暂时不考虑（或放一放）

ex.s: And consider setting a second alarm.
ex.t: 还要考虑设第二个闹钟。

defs.def: to state that a decision made by a court is not legally valid 撤销，驳回（法院的判决）；宣布无效
to write sth down on paper in order to record it 写下；记下；登记
to give sth as a rule, principle, etc. 制订，规定（规则、原则等）
to make a bomb, etc. explode 使（炸弹等）爆炸
to make an alarm start ringing 使（警报）响起；拉响（警报）

ex.s: •If a smoke detector sets off an alarm and there is no fire or smoke， inform your hall staff．
ex.t: •如果烟雾探测器发出警报但没有火灾或烟雾，通知宿舍工作人员。

defs.def: to start a process or series of events 引发；激起

ex.s: In some cases, it’s not so much the treatment of the animals on set in the studio that has activists worried; it’s the off-set training and living conditions that are raising concerns.
ex.t: 在某些情况下，让活动家担心的不一定是摄影棚内动物的待遇问题；而是场外的训练和生活条件引发了担忧。

defs.def: to make sth more noticeable or attractive by being placed near it 衬托；使显得更突出（或更漂亮）
to leave a place and begin a journey 出发；动身；启程

ex.s: I often leave early to seek the right destinations so I can set up early to avoid missing the moment I am attempting to photograph.
ex.t: 我经常早早出发去寻找合适的目的地，这样我可以提前架好设备，避免错过我想拍摄的瞬间。

ex.s: The next morning he hired a boat and set out   67   (find) the well-known painter.
ex.t: 第二天早晨，他雇了一条船，出发___67___（find）那位有名的画家。

ex.s: Emily Sanders, a 25-year-old from Detroit, Michigan, set out on December 23rd with high hopes of reaching Toronto to meet her boyfriend for Christmas.
ex.t: 来自密歇根州底特律的25岁女孩Emily Sanders在12月23日出发，满怀希望前往多伦多见男友过圣诞节。

ex.s: Set off early in the morning.
ex.t: 一大早就出发。

defs.def: to begin a job, task, etc. with a particular aim or goal （怀着目标）开始工作，展开任务

ex.s: So why should we try to set specific goals?
ex.t: 那么我们应该为什么要设定具体的目标呢？

ex.s: Instead, I agree with Oxford University philosopher Nick Bostrom, who believes that the heaviest risks from A GI do not come from a decision to turn against mankind but rather from a dogged pursuit of set objectives at the expense of everything else.
ex.t: 相反，我同意牛津大学哲学家尼克·博斯特罗姆的观点，他相信GI带来的最重风险并非来自对全人类的背叛，而是来自于以牺牲其他一切为代价，对既定目标的顽强追求。

ex.s: Make sure that you plan for these difficulties at the time of setting your goals.
ex.t: 确保你在设定目标时就为这些困难做好计划。

ex.s: The target recycling rate in these cities has been set at 55% by 2020.
ex.t: 这些城市的目标回收率被设定为到2020年达到55%。

ex.s: 40   You should reassess your goals, and motivate yourself to set a fresh goal.
ex.t: 40   你应该重新评估目标，并激励自己设定一个新目标。

ex.s: You must keep these points in mind while setting your goals.
ex.t: 设定目标时你必须记住这些要点。

ex.s: Make career plans and set goals.
ex.t: 制定职业规划并设定目标。

ex.t: 没有动力，你既无法设定目标，也无法达成目标

ex.s: Motivation and goal setting are the two sides of same coin.
ex.t: 动力和目标是同一枚硬币的两面。

ex.s: Another way of setting realistic goals is to analyze your short and long term objectives, keeping in mind your beliefs, values and strengths.
ex.t: 设定现实目标的另一种方法是分析你的短期和长期目标，同时牢记你的信念、价值观和长处。

defs.def: to arrange or display things 安排；摆放；陈列
to present ideas, facts, etc. in an organized way, in speech or writing （有条理地）陈述，阐明
to provide sb with the money that they need in order to do sth 资助，经济上扶植（某人）

ex.t: 这两个项目的更正式的经济学术语是预算集。

ex.t: 此外，研究团队还设立了一个独立的实验，表明那些模仿母亲声音最像的幼鸟得到了最多的食物。

defs.def: to make a piece of equipment or a machine ready for use 安装好，装配好，调试好（设备或机器）
to arrange for sth to happen 安排；策划
to create sth or start it 创建；建立；开办

ex.s: Set up reading groups for them.
ex.t: 为他们建立阅读小组。

ex.s: Setting up a new standard.
ex.t: 建立一个新的标准。

ex.s: Crystal set out to change that, and helped to create a global movement.
ex.t: 水晶着手改变这一点，并帮助创建了一场全球运动。

ex.s: attend job trainingD. set up a new email account
ex.t: 参加工作培训 D. 建立一个新的邮箱账户

ex.s: Background information Yellowstone National Park was set up in 1872.It covers an area of about 9,000 square kilometres, and there are lakes, canyons, rivers and mountains.
ex.t: 背景信息：黄石国家公园于1872年建立，占地面积约9000平方公里，有湖泊、峡谷、河流和山脉。

ex.t: 经过三年试点期，GPNP将于明年正式建立。

ex.t: 建立社交平台。D.促进语言学习。

ex.t: 因此我们谈论的不是去适应一个新的标准，而是去适应一组不断变化的条件。

ex.s: In a recycling economy, we would make one set of 100 cans to start with, then replace them over and over again with recycled cans.
ex.t: 在一个循环回收经济中，我们会先制造一组100个罐子，然后再用回收的罐子反复替换它们。

ex.s: There is no point in arguing if the universe is a clock, a set of particles or an output of computation.
ex.t: 争论宇宙是一座钟、一组粒子还是计算的输出，是毫无意义的。

ex.t: 哪个餐厅会提供一套大菜单？

ex.t: 它包括一组情绪技能。

ex.s: Mann said Terrafugia was helped by the Federal Aviation  Administration’s decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find relatively easy to meet.

ex.t: 环境设计公司的梅里特及其团队在根球下方安装了一个平台，由直径7英寸、长44英尺的钢条构成，钢条正下方是第一组未充气的气囊（灰色所示）。团队还挖了一条浅坡道。

ex.s: The two sets of waves cancel each other out.
ex.t: 嗯，它的工作原理是分析传入声波并产生第二组传出声波。

ex.t: 它通过分析传入声波的波形，并产生第二组传出声波来工作。

ex.s: decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes.
ex.t: 五年前做出的为轻型运动飞机制定一套单独标准的决定，这些标准低于大型飞机飞行员所需的标准。

defs.def: a group of objects used together, for example for playing a game 一套，一副，一组（配套使用的东西）

ex.s: Rather than setting plans in stone, I’ve learned that sometimes I need to take the opportunities that are offered, even if they don’t sound perfect at the time, and make the most of them.
ex.t: 与其把计划定死，我学到了有时候我需要抓住提供的机会，即使当时听起来并不完美，并且充分利用它们。

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了“人类约30万年前进化时所有语音都已存在”的流行观点。“我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来未必保持稳定，我们今天发现的极其多样的语音，是生物变化和文化演变等事物复杂相互作用的产物，”研究团队成员史蒂文·莫兰说。

defs.def: a group of people who have similar interests and spend a lot of time together socially 一伙（或一帮、一群）人；阶层；团伙

ex.s: For those extremely hungry there’s a large set menu.
ex.t: 对于极度饥饿的人，这里有大型套餐菜单。

ex.t: 当探险者首次踏上北美大陆时，天空和大地充满了惊人多样的野生动物。

ex.t: 最近，我们买了一辆二十八英尺长的旅居拖车，配有浴室和内置电视机。

defs.def: the scenery used for a play, film/movie, etc. 布景

ex.t: 难道这些布景不让你想去参观那个地方吗？

defs.def: a place where a play is performed or part of a film/movie is filmed 舞台；摄影场

ex.s: While high school does not generally encourage students to explore new aspects of life, college sets the stage for that exploration.
ex.t: 虽然高中通常不鼓励学生探索生活的新方面，但大学为这种探索搭建了舞台。

defs.def: one section of a match in games such as tennis or volleyball （网球、排球比赛等的）盘，局
a group of things that have a shared quality 集；集合

ex.t: Steven Moran对人类语音集合有什么看法？

defs.def: a series of songs or pieces of music that a musician or group performs at a concert 一组歌曲（或乐曲）
a group of school students with a similar ability in a particular subject （在某学科上能力相当的）一批学生

an act of arranging hair in a particular style while it is wet 头发的定型；做头发
the state of becoming firm or solid 凝固；凝结
a young plant, shoot etc. for planting （供移植的）秧苗，插枝，球茎
in a particular position 位于（或处于）… 的

ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一个小镇。有一天放学后，在探索这座壮丽山峰的翠绿树林时，我差点被一段台阶绊倒。这些台阶会通向哪里呢？好奇心占了上风，因为我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始攀登那些神秘莫测的台阶。

ex.t: 《二十年后》 短篇小说《二十年后》设定在纽约一个寒冷黑暗的夜晚。
